entities.name: Squalene-hopene cyclase P54924
observations: The supplied 660-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt P54924 from Bradyrhizobium diazoefficiens.
Catalyzes squalene cyclization to hopene; assigned to hopanoid biosynthesis.
Reference annotation places the enzyme at the cell membrane as a peripheral membrane protein.
Pfam detects SQHop_cyclase_N (PF13249) and SQHop_cyclase_C (PF13243) domains in the query sequence.
